description: issue #691: each melody pitch MUST be a `note`-accepted scientific-pitch-notation word or the literal "rest"; a malformed pitch (here "h9" - `h` is not a note letter a-g) raises `ol-type` at runtime with expected:"pitch", reusing `note`'s validator and diagnostic identity (spec/interaction-events.md:301-303). No `sound` event is emitted. The instruction event is still emitted before the diagnostic halts the statement.
